$comment: Convention-proof example only (not a production contract). Shape is borrowed from C6's ForwardReceipt honesty discipline: the 'simulated' flag must be present so a simulated receipt can never be mistaken for a measured one.

action.description: Closed disposition vocabulary -- open strings are how drift enters.

decision_id.description: Correlates the receipt to the decision it records.

simulated.description: True when this receipt was produced by a mock/drill path (cf. C6). Never inferred -- always declared.
